import contextlib, io, json, runpy, subprocess, sys, tempfile

tempfile.tempdir=str(evidence)
# Only the report destination/storage is adapted in memory; all CLI checks remain intact.
reports={}
report.create_run_directory=lambda root, command: evidence
report.write_json=lambda path, value: reports.update({Path(path).name:value})
def cli(args):
 sys.argv=['tools/i18n',*args]
 out=io.StringIO()
 with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
  try: runpy.run_path('tools/i18n',run_name='__main__')
  except SystemExit as e: code=e.code or 0
 print('COMMAND: python3 -B tools/i18n '+' '.join(args)); print(out.getvalue(),end=''); print('EXIT:',code)
 assert code==0

doctor_output=cli(['doctor'])
fix=json.loads((task/'FIX3-TARGETS.json').read_text()); adj=json.loads((task/'ADJUDICATION-F2.json').read_text()); work=json.loads((task/'WORKSET.json').read_text())['items']
assert set(fix)=={f['revision_key'] for f in adj['findings'] if f['status']=='confirmed'}
files=json.loads((task/'SCOPE.json').read_text())['allowed_files']
loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
loader.runtime.doctor()
before_bytes={f:(root/f).read_bytes() for f in files}
before={f:loader.load_bytes(before_bytes[f],logical_path=f).records for f in files}
baseline={f:loader.load_path(task/'baseline'/f,logical_path=f).records for f in files}
for key,x in fix.items():
 old=('[[ '+x['old_target']+' ]]') # Delimiters are checked explicitly below, no normalization.
 old_literal=('[[%s]]'%x['old_target']).encode(); new_literal=('[[%s]]'%x['new_target']).encode()
 data=before_bytes[x['file']]
 assert data.count(old_literal)==1,(key,'literal occurrence')
 at=data.index(old_literal)
 assert data[:at].rfind(('section(%s)'%json.dumps(x['section'])).encode())>=0
 (root/x['file']).write_bytes(data.replace(old_literal,new_literal,1))
 print('REPLACED',key,'LF',x['old_target'].count('\n'),'->',x['new_target'].count('\n'))
 print('BEFORE:',json.dumps(x['old_target'],ensure_ascii=False)); print('AFTER:',json.dumps(x['new_target'],ensure_ascii=False))
after={f:loader.load_path(root/f,logical_path=f).records for f in files}
def semantic(r): return {k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='line'}
def key_for(f,r): return (f,r.get('section'),r.get('source'),r.get('source_tag'))
work_keys={key_for(x['normalized_path'],x) for x in work}
fix_keys={key_for(x['normalized_path'],x):x['entry_revision_identity'] for x in work if x['entry_revision_identity'] in fix}
counts={}; delta=[]
for f in files:
 assert len(baseline[f])==len(before[f])==len(after[f])
 count=0
 for b,p,a in zip(baseline[f],before[f],after[f]):
  b,p,a=map(semantic,(b,p,a)); k=key_for(f,a)
  assert {z:v for z,v in b.items() if z!='target'}=={z:v for z,v in a.items() if z!='target'},(f,'non-target baseline drift')
  assert {z:v for z,v in p.items() if z!='target'}=={z:v for z,v in a.items() if z!='target'},(f,'non-target round drift')
  if b.get('target')!=a.get('target'):
   assert k in work_keys; count+=1
  if p!=a:
   assert k in fix_keys
   rk=fix_keys[k]; assert p['target']==fix[rk]['old_target']; assert a['target']==fix[rk]['new_target']; delta.append(rk)
 counts[f]=count
assert sum(counts.values())==106,counts
assert set(delta)==set(fix) and len(delta)==2
for rk,x in fix.items():
 expected=4 if rk.startswith('616ed') else 1
 assert x['new_target'].count('\n')==expected
 if expected==4: assert all(not line.startswith((' ','\t')) for line in x['new_target'].split('\n'))
 expected_bytes=before_bytes[x['file']].replace(('[[%s]]'%x['old_target']).encode(),('[[%s]]'%x['new_target']).encode(),1)
 assert (root/x['file']).read_bytes()==expected_bytes
for f in set(files)-{x['file'] for x in fix.values()}: assert (root/f).read_bytes()==before_bytes[f]
print('LUAJIT BASELINE CHECK: PASS',json.dumps(counts),'total=106; round delta=2; new_target exact; all other records unchanged')
lint_output=cli(['lint','--strict'])
r=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],capture_output=True,text=True); print('COMMAND: git diff --check\nEXIT:',r.returncode); print(r.stdout+r.stderr,end=''); assert r.returncode==0
validation_path=evidence/'VALIDATION.json'; validation=json.loads(validation_path.read_text())
validation['review_cycle_3_repair']={'confirmed_findings':2,'changed_targets':delta,'only_adjudicated_replacements_changed':True,'targets':fix}
validation['checks']['review_cycle_3']={'luajit_baseline_record_comparison':{'result':'passed','changed_targets':106,'counts_by_file':counts,'round_delta':2,'new_targets_exact':True,'other_records_unchanged':True,'args_order_unchanged':True,'literal_forms_preserved':'[[...]]'},'doctor':{'command':'python3 -B tools/i18n doctor','result':'passed','output':doctor_output},'git_diff_check':{'command':'git diff --check','result':'passed','exit_code':0},'strict_lint':{'command':'python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict','result':'passed','exit_code':0,'report_storage_note':'CLI executed through runpy with in-memory report destination/storage adapters; report saved inline here. Temporary locale bridge files confined to this evidence directory and removed automatically. No .artifacts writes.','report':reports['lint.json']}}
validation_path.write_text(json.dumps(validation,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
with (evidence/'IMPLEMENTATION.md').open('a') as h:
 h.write('\n## Repair round 3 (ADJUDICATION-F2)\n\n')
 for rk,x in fix.items():
  h.write('- `'+rk+'` (`'+x['file']+'`, `'+x['section']+'`): exact full target replacement from `FIX3-TARGETS.json`; original Lua long brackets preserved.\n')
  h.write('  - Before (JSON escapes): '+json.dumps(x['old_target'],ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
  h.write('  - After (JSON escapes): '+json.dumps(x['new_target'],ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
 h.write('- LuaJIT loaded the four files before/after and their frozen baselines: exactly 106 baseline target changes (78 / 7 / 11 / 10), exactly two round changes, both equal to `new_target`; all other semantic records and `args_order` unchanged. Nether Spark LF 6 → 4 with no line indentation; Quantum Feed LF 2 → 1 with final-line two-tab indentation preserved.\n- Doctor passed (existing unpinned DLC warnings); strict lint passed, 30308 translations, 0 errors, 0 warnings; `git diff --check` passed.\n- To respect the no-`.artifacts` constraint, the unchanged CLI was executed via `runpy` with report destination/storage adapted in memory; the full lint report is inline in `VALIDATION.json`. Temporary Lua bridge files stayed in this evidence directory and were automatically removed.\n- No stage, commit, push, agent creation, task-record, terminology, or other entry changes.\n')
r=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],capture_output=True,text=True); assert r.returncode==0,(r.stdout,r.stderr)
for f in ['IMPLEMENTATION.md','VALIDATION.json']:
 r=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--no-index','--check','--','/dev/null',str(evidence/f)],capture_output=True,text=True)
 assert r.returncode in (0,1) and not r.stdout and not r.stderr,(f,r.stdout,r.stderr)
print('FINAL EVIDENCE WHITESPACE: PASS')
